title: County heritage fair
brief: The original delivery of six crates of scale models to county hall delivery bay has fallen through. The heritage volunteers needs a replacement shipment in time for the display table handover. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Morgan

Remy, when will all six be ready? Alex, can you quote a service that guarantees handover by 12:15? Quinn, can you confirm whether the quote is within budget?

Morgan, when is the county hall bay open, and what’s the latest arrival that works for handover? Alex, please quote a service for today that fits those times and confirm the total so I can authorize the booking.
